help.title: Help
help.start.intro: DodoTopia prepares your work here, then carries it out in Heartopia for you: it presses the keys and clicks on your behalf. The game must be open when you start.
help.start.activities.title: The three activities
help.start.activities.music: Music: play a MIDI file on one of the game's instruments.
help.start.activities.draw: Drawing: reproduce an image on the canvas, cell by cell.
help.start.activities.cook: Cooking: cook the last recipe on a loop.
help.start.activities.note: Music works right after installation. Drawing and cooking need a one-time setup.
help.gloss.midi.def: A score: the list of notes and their durations, with no recorded sound. DodoTopia replays it on the keys of the game's instrument.
help.gloss.listen.def: Listen to the song in DodoTopia, through the computer's speakers. Nothing is sent to Heartopia.
help.gloss.transpose.def: Shift every note down or up, in semitones, so they fit within the instrument's range.
help.gloss.audio_sync.def: Play together without a network: the first player plays a cue note in the game, DodoTopia hears it on the audio output and everyone starts at the same time.
help.gloss.room.def: Play together through the DodoTopia server: a 6-character code, a host, a shared song and a start given by the server.
help.gloss.offset.def: A deliberate offset, in milliseconds, applied to your start: negative to play earlier, positive to play later.
help.gloss.calib.def: Show DodoTopia once where the drawing canvas, the palette and the game's tools are on the screen. Without it, it doesn't know where to click.
help.gloss.dither.def: Alternate two neighbouring colours cell by cell to imitate a shade the palette lacks.
help.gloss.outline.def: Trace the edge of an area with the pencil, then fill it with a single bucket click instead of painting every cell.
help.music.import.title: Import a song
help.music.import.s1: Music › My library › Import, or drop a .mid file onto the window.
help.music.import.s2: Files are copied into your songs folder; the original is left untouched.
help.music.import.note: You can also grab a shared song: Music › Discover › Add to my library.
help.music.instrument.title: Choose my instrument
help.music.instrument.s1: In Heartopia, open the instrument you want to play.
help.music.instrument.s2: In DodoTopia, “Play in Heartopia” block › Change (or {f12}), and pick the same type.
help.music.instrument.s3: Choosing here equips nothing in the game: DodoTopia adapts to your instrument.
help.music.instrument.note: If the notes sound wrong, it's almost always because the chosen instrument isn't the one open in the game.
help.music.play.title: Play in the game
help.music.play.s1: Select a song, keep Heartopia in the foreground, instrument open.
help.music.play.s3: To take back control: <kbd class="kbd">{f7}</kbd>, any key or a left click.
help.music.play.note: “Preview” plays the song through the computer's speakers: nothing is sent to the game.
help.music.together.title: Play together
help.music.together.s1: Music › Play together, then choose a method.
help.music.together.s2: By sound: no network, the first player plays a cue note that the others detect.
help.music.together.s3: Online room: a six-character code, a host who starts the session.
help.music.together.note: Timing depends on your machine and your connection: starts are adjusted as well as possible, not perfectly.
help.draw.prepare.title: Prepare an image
help.draw.prepare.s2: The preview shows the cell-by-cell result using the colours of the game's palette.
help.draw.prepare.s3: Adjust the format, framing and colours in the right-hand panel.
help.draw.prepare.note: Transparent cells show as a checkerboard. If “Fill the background with the bucket” is ticked, they will take the background colour in the game.
help.draw.setup.title: Set up the canvas
help.draw.setup.s1: In Heartopia, open a canvas in the chosen format, detail level at maximum, grid enabled.
help.draw.setup.s2: Set up the game area button: the assistant asks for one position at a time.
help.draw.setup.s3: Place the mouse on the target in the game and press {f3}.
help.draw.setup.note: The setup is kept. Redo it if you change resolution or window size.
help.draw.run.title: Start the drawing
help.draw.run.s1: Open an empty canvas in the right format, pencil tool selected, no zoom.
help.draw.run.s2: Draw in Heartopia button or {f6}, then don't touch the mouse.
help.draw.run.note: An interrupted drawing resumes where it stopped: start it again on the same canvas, only the missing cells are painted.
help.cook.setup.title: Set up cooking
help.cook.setup.s1: In the game, stand in front of the stove, bubble visible.
help.cook.setup.s2: Cooking › Set up cooking, then follow the steps one by one.
help.cook.setup.s3: Each position is captured with <kbd class="kbd">{f3}</kbd>.
help.cook.setup.note: Test the detection is optional: it reads the screen and says which bubble is recognised. You can start the loop without it.
help.cook.run.title: Start the loop
help.cook.run.s1: Cook the wanted recipe once yourself: DodoTopia repeats the game's last recipe.
help.cook.run.s2: Choose Set quantity or Endless, and the number of stoves.
help.cook.run.s3: Stand in front of the stove, then <kbd class="kbd">{f6}</kbd>.
help.cook.run.note: During the loop, <kbd class="kbd">{f7}</kbd>, any key or a mouse movement stops everything.
help.keys.title: Global shortcuts
help.keys.intro: Active even when Heartopia is in the foreground. Editable in Settings › Shortcuts.
help.fix.keys.q: The game doesn't receive the keys
help.fix.keys.a: Heartopia must be the active window. If nothing gets through, restart DodoTopia as administrator.
help.fix.notes.a: Check that the chosen instrument is the one open in the game. Otherwise, try Settings › Music and audio › Advanced › Key sending.
help.fix.draw.q: The drawing is shifted or distorted
help.fix.draw.a: Redo “Set up the game area” for this format: the setup depends on the resolution and the window position.
help.fix.cook.a: Run “Test the detection” in front of the stove, then recapture the bubble icons.
help.fix.stop.a: <kbd class="kbd">{f7}</kbd>, any key or a left click stops the automation in progress.
